title: Bank of America backs 1%–4% crypto allocation, opens door to Bitcoin ETFs
summary: Bank of America’s wealthiest clients will gain access to Bitcoin ETFs, while its network of over 15,000 wealth advisers can recommend crypto exposure for the first time, Yahoo reported.

title: CZ-owned Trust Wallet debuts prediction markets starting with Myriad
summary: Trust Wallet is the latest crypto wallet to tap into prediction markets, starting with Myriad, highlighting an increasing trend of bundled trading tools.

title: Bitcoin's ‘more reliable’ RSI variant hits bear market bottom zone at $87K
summary: Bitcoin velocity RSI produced a rare bear market bottom signal as BTC price losses sparked a return to extreme "oversold" conditions.

title: UK considers ban on crypto donations to political parties: Politico
summary: The UK is reportedly considering a ban on political crypto donations as Reform UK tops the polls, raising questions about funding transparency and potential foreign influence.

title: Anthropic study says AI agents developed $4.6M in smart contract bugs
summary: Commercial AI models were able to autonomously generate real-world smart contract exploits worth millions; the costs of such attacks are falling rapidly.

title: RedotPay taps Ripple to roll out Nigerian naira crypto cashouts
summary: RedotPay said users can convert cryptocurrency into Nigerian naira and receive funds directly in their local bank accounts within minutes.

title: Bitcoin valuation metric projects 96% chance of BTC price recovery in 2026
summary: A similar setup in 2023 preceded a 340% Bitcoin rally, reinforcing the argument that BTC is undervalued at current prices.

title: Bitcoin to end four-year cycle, break out to new highs in 2026: Grayscale
summary: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s 2025 sell-off looks like a local bottom, not a new cycle peak, with Fed policy and US crypto bills key for 2026.

title: Digital asset treasury boom stalls as flows drop to $1.3B and stocks tumble
summary: Bitcoin treasury companies drove November inflows with $1.06 billion, as Ether saw $37 million in outflows despite continued accumulation by BitMine.

title: Bitcoin battles $50K price target as Fed adds $13.5B overnight liquidity
summary: Bitcoin liquidity cues received a clear signal from the Fed, as the end of QT sparked the second-largest overnight liquidity injection since the COVID-19 era.
